opinions: SEXUAL ORIENTATION IS A NATURAL PART OF HUMAN VARIATION, AND THE CLAIM THAT NO ONE CAN FEEL NATURALLY HOMOSEXUAL IS FALSE AND HARMFUL.
RETRIBUTIVE 'EYE FOR AN EYE' JUSTICE IS MORALLY PRIMITIVE AND USUALLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE TO BUILDING A BETTER SOCIETY.
CLIMATE SCIENCE CLEARLY SHOWS THAT INFINITE ECONOMIC GROWTH ON A FINITE PLANET IS UNSUSTAINABLE, AND POLITICIANS SHOULD STOP PROMISING IT AS THE PRIMARY GOAL.
CLASS DIVISIONS ARE OFTEN MORE FUNDAMENTAL TO PEOPLE'S MATERIAL CONDITIONS AND LIFE CHANCES THAN NATIONALITY, THOUGH BOTH MATTER.
WHAT CONSENTING ADULTS DO IN PRIVATE IS NONE OF THE STATE'S BUSINESS, FULL STOP.
STRATEGIC PROTECTIONISM CAN SOMETIMES BE JUSTIFIED TO PROTECT VITAL INDUSTRIES OR WORKERS, THOUGH FREE TRADE GENERALLY PRODUCES MORE OVERALL PROSPERITY.
AVOIDING PROBLEMS THROUGH DISTRACTION IS USUALLY A BAD LONG-TERM STRATEGY; FACING TROUBLES DIRECTLY IS HEALTHIER.
WHILE ALL CULTURES DESERVE RESPECT, SOME ARE CLEARLY MORE HUMANE, FREE, AND CONDUCIVE TO HUMAN FLOURISHING THAN OTHERS.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD NOT BE FORCED TO SUBSIDIZE ARTS INSTITUTIONS THAT CANNOT ATTRACT ENOUGH VOLUNTARY SUPPORT.
MORALITY DOES NOT REQUIRE RELIGION; SECULAR ETHICS BASED ON REASON AND EMPATHY ARE ENTIRELY SUFFICIENT.
CONSENSUAL SEX BETWEEN ADULTS OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT IMMORAL.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE STRONG ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATION BECAUSE PROFIT MOTIVES ALONE FREQUENTLY LEAD TO DESTRUCTIVE EXTERNALITIES.
REHABILITATION SHOULD BE ATTEMPTED WITH ALMOST ALL CRIMINALS; WRITING SOME OFF AS IRREDEEMABLE IS BOTH INHUMANE AND OFTEN SELF-DEFEATING.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND FREQUENTLY DO BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED INTO THEIR NEW COUNTRIES.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL, ESPECIALLY IN THE EARLY STAGES OF PREGNANCY WHEN THE WOMAN'S BODILY AUTONOMY IS PARAMOUNT.
COMPANIES HAVE SOCIAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITIES THAT GO WELL BEYOND MAXIMIZING SHAREHOLDER PROFIT.
PUBLIC FUNDING FOR INDEPENDENT BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS LIKE THE BBC CAN SERVE A VALUABLE PUBLIC GOOD THAT MARKETS ALONE MAY NOT PROVIDE.
FREE MARKETS GENERALLY PROMOTE LIBERTY, BUT THEY CAN ALSO PRODUCE CONCENTRATIONS OF POWER THAT UNDERMINE FREEDOM.
'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED' IS A NOBLE IDEAL THAT UNFORTUNATELY TENDS TO FAIL DUE TO PROBLEMS OF INCENTIVES AND KNOWLEDGE.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; MORAL JUDGMENT SHOULD NOT BE SUSPENDED BASED ON TEMPORARY TACTICAL ALLIANCES.
SCHOOLING SHOULD DEVELOP WELL-ROUNDED, CRITICAL-THINKING CITIZENS, NOT MERELY FUNCTION AS JOB TRAINING.
WHAT IS GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS OFTEN NOT GOOD FOR SOCIETY AS A WHOLE.
MASS SURVEILLANCE THREATENS EVERYONE'S PRIVACY AND CIVIL LIBERTIES, NOT JUST THOSE OF WRONGDOERS.
A HEALTHY CIVILIZED SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE RIGID HIERARCHIES OF COMMAND AND OBEDIENCE.
I WILL NOT SUPPORT MY COUNTRY WHEN IT IS WRONG; PATRIOTISM SHOULD BE CONDITIONAL ON MORAL BEHAVIOR.
WHILE PEOPLE HAVE THE RIGHT TO FREE ASSOCIATION, OFFICIAL POLICIES ENCOURAGING ETHNIC OR CULTURAL SEPARATION ARE DIVISIVE AND WRONG.
COMPULSORY SCHOOL ATTENDANCE IS GENERALLY NECESSARY TO ENSURE CHILDREN RECEIVE AN EDUCATION AND ARE PROTECTED FROM NEGLECT.
IT IS NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME AGE-APPROPRIATE SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS LARGELY BEEN A POSITIVE DEVELOPMENT, THOUGH SOME BOUNDARIES REMAIN APPROPRIATE.
MAKING PEACE WITH UNJUST ASPECTS OF THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT A NECESSARY OR DESIRABLE PART OF MATURITY.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY TAKE PRIORITY OVER PURE PUNISHMENT WHERE IT IS FEASIBLE.
LUCK EXISTS AND PLAYS A MAJOR ROLE IN LIFE OUTCOMES, THOUGH 'NATURALLY UNLUCKY' IS A MISLEADING FRAMING.
IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED; MANY COULD REASONABLY CONTRIBUTE MORE.
THE ARGUMENTS AND DELAYS OF DEMOCRACY ARE A FEATURE, NOT A BUG; ONE-PARTY STATES CONCENTRATE TOO MUCH DANGEROUS POWER.
LAND CAN BE BOUGHT AND SOLD, BUT SOCIETIES SHOULD USE TAXATION AND REGULATION TO PREVENT HARMFUL SPECULATION AND ENSURE FAIR ACCESS.
IT IS INDEED FOOLISH TO FEEL PRIDE IN ONE'S COUNTRY OF BIRTH SINCE IT IS AN ACCIDENT OF BIRTH, THOUGH ONE CAN BE PROUD OF ITS ACHIEVEMENTS.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS RARELY JUSTIFIED AND SETS DANGEROUS PRECEDENTS.
GOVERNMENTS ABSOLUTELY SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT DELIBERATELY MISLEAD THE PUBLIC.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS GENERALLY SUPERIOR TO PRIVATE CHARITY FOR RELIABLY HELPING THE DISADVANTAGED AT SCALE.
WRITERS, ARTISTS, AND CREATORS ARE AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT TO A GOOD SOCIETY AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS INDEED DEGRADED PUBLIC DISCOURSE AND UNDERSTANDING.
HEALTHCARE IS A FUNDAMENTAL GOOD THAT SHOULD NOT BE ALLOCATED PURELY ACCORDING TO ABILITY TO PAY.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS CONTROLLING INFLATION.
POSSESSING SMALL AMOUNTS OF MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENSE.
STABLE, LOVING SAME-SEX COUPLES SHOULD BE ABLE TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULTS.
PHYSICAL SPANKING IS AN INFERIOR AND POTENTIALLY HARMFUL FORM OF DISCIPLINE; BETTER METHODS EXIST.
PEOPLE WITH INHERITABLE DISABILITIES HAVE THE SAME REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS AS ANYONE ELSE; EUGENICS IS WRONG.
ABSTRACT ART IS LEGITIMATE ART; ARTISTIC VALUE IS NOT LIMITED TO LITERAL REPRESENTATION.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD INDEED BE QUESTIONED AND REQUIRED TO JUSTIFY ITSELF.
IF GLOBALIZATION IS INEVITABLE, IT SHOULD BE STEERED TO SERVE HUMAN WELLBEING AND DIGNITY RATHER THAN CORPORATE INTERESTS.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR INHERENT QUALITIES COMPARED TO OTHERS; RACISM IS FALSE AND DESTRUCTIVE.
ASTROLOGY IS PSEUDOSCIENCE WITH NO CREDIBLE EXPLANATORY POWER.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS SHOULD SHARE PARENTING AND CAREER RESPONSIBILITIES ACCORDING TO THEIR PREFERENCES AND ABILITIES.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE RULES PREVENTING MONOPOLIES AND PREDATORY BEHAVIOR.
IT IS INDEED REGRETTABLE WHEN LARGE FORTUNES ARE MADE THROUGH PURE FINANCIAL MANIPULATION RATHER THAN CREATING REAL VALUE.
CHILDREN SHOULD LEARN CRITICAL THINKING, CREATIVITY, AND EMPATHY AT LEAST AS MUCH AS THEY LEARN TO ACCEPT DISCIPLINE.
THOSE WHO CAN WORK BUT REFUSE TO SHOULD FACE CONSEQUENCES, THOUGH SOCIETY SHOULD ENSURE GENUINE OPPORTUNITIES EXIST.
THE DEATH PENALTY IS IMMORAL, INEFFECTIVE AS A DETERRENT, AND SHOULD BE ABOLISHED.
SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT INSTILL SPECIFIC RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD BE SECULAR.
CIVIL LIBERTIES HAVE BEEN EXCESSIVELY CURTAILED IN MANY COUNTRIES UNDER THE BANNER OF COUNTER-TERRORISM.
THE COMMODIFICATION OF DRINKING WATER AS BRANDED BOTTLED PRODUCTS IS INDEED A SAD REFLECTION ON MODERN CONSUMER CULTURE.
